known_limitations.impact: Exact Team GO Rocket party rankings remain unavailable when current opponent move assignments, scaling, timing, damage, and survivability inputs are incomplete. Rocket guidance must continue to expose that uncertainty instead of presenting an exact ranking as verified.
known_limitations.notes: Tracked by #144. Existing battle-input gates keep unsupported exact rankings from being presented as verified.
